broadcast.text: divinethought adds rookie tight end Harold Fannin as rosters dig into the youth late in the tenth.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: D1LLIGAF grabs J.K. Dobbins at 10.03 — a real lead-back talent as the THIRD runner behind Henry and Walker. If he's right, that's a league-winner riding the bench.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: Matthew Stafford to jgirsby at 10.07 — a proven veteran arm for the bench as quarterbacks keep trickling off.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Another defense off the board — jsdivine takes the Broncos unit at 10.06 as the streaming run rolls on.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Tenth round and the contenders are patching holes — D1LLIGAF's been done patching since round one. Chase, Harrison, McLaurin, Henry, Walker: no weaknesses left to cover.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: Defenses start flying — the Seahawks to mmcatee01, the Texans to BrennaLynne — the streaming positions getting claimed.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: sammyyy29 fills the tight end slot as managers lock down their starting lineups in the tenth.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: A Denver cluster forms — Bo Nix, Courtland Sutton, and rookie RJ Harvey all landing in a short stretch. Someone's betting big on the Broncos' offense.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: The streaming positions arrive — ITouchd0wnThere grabs the Rams defense and Bo Nix goes to alyssagenther as the ninth round winds down.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: And mmcatee01 burns a NINTH-round pick on a kicker — a Dallas one, no less. In this booth we don't dignify that name. Meanwhile D1LLIGAF just keeps stacking Chase-and-Harrison firepower.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: Rico Dowdle to sammyyy29 at 9.07 — quiet running-back depth as rosters round into shape in the ninth.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: While the room scrambles for tight ends, D1LLIGAF checked that box ages ago with Dalton Kincaid. Chase, Harrison, McLaurin, Kincaid — the home team's just adding lottery tickets now.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: Tight ends going back-to-back — Kelce, then Tucker Kraft to BrennaLynne — a late positional run in the ninth.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Travis Kelce slides to jsdivine at 9.05 — a first-ballot Hall of Famer landing as a ninth-round tight end. Age is the only reason he's here.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Michael Wilson to jgirsby at 9.04 — a steady possession piece as the ninth round fills out depth charts.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Luxury? That's a Commanders stack, folks — Jayden Daniels throwing to Terry McLaurin, burgundy and gold on the home team's bench. Best QB room AND the best insurance in the league.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: D1LLIGAF spends a ninth-rounder on a second quarterback in Jayden Daniels — a luxury, with Lamar Jackson already locked in as the starter.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: DK Metcalf to divinethought at 9.02 — a big-bodied field-stretcher adding some juice to that receiver room in the ninth.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Dawnieo doubles up at the turn — Tony Pollard, then Brian Thomas — a back-and-receiver combo bridging into the ninth round.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Veteran backs on the move — Rhamondre Stevenson and Tony Pollard both land in the eighth as managers restock with proven touches.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Marvin Harrison to D1LLIGAF at 8.08 — a former top-five overall receiver falling into the EIGHTH round. Chase, DeVonta, McLaurin, now MHJ. This roster is a felony.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: Eighth round, and the contenders are still scrambling for pieces D1LLIGAF locked up ages ago — Chase, McLaurin, Henry. The home team is just watching the board now.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: Carnell Tate to jgirsby at 8.07 — yet another rookie receiver off the board as the youth movement rolls deep into the eighth round.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Backfield reinforcements flying — Jaylen Warren, Chuba Hubbard and Josh Jacobs all land as managers shore up running back into the eighth.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Alec Pierce to sammyyy29 adds a field-stretcher as the eighth round settles into depth pieces and dart throws.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Caleb Williams to ITouchd0wnThere is a swing on upside — but D1LLIGAF already has the reigning MVP in Lamar Jackson locked under center. The edge stays home.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: A Chicago cluster is forming — Rome Odunze, Caleb Williams and Luther Burden all off in a short window. Someone's quietly cornering the Bears' passing game.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Rome Odunze opens the back of the seventh to alyssagenther — the rookie receiver run has real legs now.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: A rookie-back rush to close the round — Jadarian Price, TreVeyon Henderson and Bhayshul Tuten all off as managers chase upside in the backfield.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Value keeps falling — Davante Adams at 7.06, Mike Evans at 7.07. Two decorated, thousand-yard resumes sliding all the way into the seventh.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Christian Watson to jsdivine adds a vertical element — the seventh round turning into a blend of proven names and boom-or-bust upside.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Dalton Kincaid to D1LLIGAF at 7.03 — and now the home team has its tight end to go with Chase, DeVonta, McLaurin, Henry, Walker and Lamar. Point to the hole. I'll wait.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: Three rounds of receiver dominance — Chase, DeVonta, and now Terry McLaurin. Whatever D1LLIGAF does next, that trio already won this draft.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: Quinshon Judkins, DJ Moore, Drake Maye, then Parker Washington — the board turns into the seventh with rookies and depth pieces going in bunches.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: And there it is — Terry McLaurin to D1LLIGAF at 6.08. Scary Terry joins Chase and DeVonta. The home team just built the best receiver room in the league, full stop.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: D'Andre Swift lands with jgirsby at 6.07 — a bell-cow back falling into the sixth as the room chases quarterbacks and tight ends.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: A quarterback flurry — Justin Herbert at 6.04, Jalen Hurts right behind at 6.05. The QB1 tier is nearly picked clean.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: 6.03 George Kittle, 6.06 Kyle Pitts — the tight-end position is flying now, mmcatee01 and jsdivine both spending up to get theirs.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Emeka Egbuka off to ITouchd0wnThere at 6.02 — the rookie receiver run is officially underway in the sixth.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Garrett Wilson at 6.01 to alyssagenther — fine receiver. But D1LLIGAF's Chase-and-DeVonta room isn't losing sleep over anybody else's WR3.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: 5.10 — alyssagenther grabs Tyler Warren, and tight end is getting raided early. Five of them off the board already in a receiver-driven year.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: David Montgomery in at 5.09 as jsdivine keeps stacking the backfield. On to the back half of the draft.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: 5.06 — BrennaLynne gambles on Malik Nabers off the knee. Ceiling is a WR1; the floor is a training-room update.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Lamar Jackson to D1LLIGAF at 5.03 — the reigning cheat code as your fifth-round QB. Chase, Henry, Walker, Smith, now Lamar. This is getting unfair.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: The quarterback board thins fast — Lamar Jackson at 5.03, Joe Burrow at 5.08. If you wanted an MVP under center, that window is nearly shut.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: D1LLIGAF adds DeVonta Smith at 4.03 — a WR2 who plays like a WR1. Chase and Smith? Somebody's out here starting Montorie Foster, and it isn't the home team.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: A receiver avalanche in the fourth — Nico Collins, Chris Olave, Tee Higgins, then Ladd McConkey. Five wideouts in a seven-pick window.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Brock Bowers and Trey McBride come early — jgirsby and ITouchd0wnThere spend premium capital at tight end while the room chases wideouts.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Josh Allen is the first quarterback off the board at 3.05 to jsdivine — the position finally cracks the top twenty-five.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: 3.03 — Kenneth Walker to D1LLIGAF. The last true workhorse on the board falls to the home team. Henry AND Walker? Start engraving the trophy.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: Chase Brown and Ashton Jeanty go back-to-back — a genuine run on the backfield, nobody wanting to be last one standing at the position.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: While the room reaches, D1LLIGAF lands Derrick Henry at 2.03 — a 2,000-yard back as the RB2 next to Chase. That's not a pick, that's a heist.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: 2.04 — sammyyy29 selects Montorie Foster. In the second round. We'll let that one breathe, folks.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Justin Jefferson to ITouchd0wnThere, Saquon Barkley to mmcatee01 — the elite tier is evaporating two names at a time.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: alyssagenther pairs Amon-Ra with Christian McCaffrey at the 2.01 turn — tidy. Pity D1LLIGAF already banked the best player in football in Ja'Marr Chase.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: De'Von Achane and Amon-Ra St. Brown close the round — alyssagenther wheeling at the turn with a back-and-receiver haul in hand.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: 1.08 — mmcatee01 takes Jonathan Taylor, and that's six running backs in the first eight. The position run this room drafts around.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: And it traces straight back to slot three — D1LLIGAF landing the WR1 is what broke the dam after two RBs opened the round.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: 1.06 — BrennaLynne takes Jaxon Smith-Njigba. That's three WRs in the last four picks — a genuine receiver run on the front of round one.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Cook's fine, but jsdivine just watched the WR tier get picked clean while D1LLIGAF banked the best one. Advantage: home team.
broadcast.speaker: homer
